title: eria dujakorum
intro: Eria dujakorum, commonly known as a type of orchid, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of India. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Eria dujakorum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Further research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Eria dujakorum, but it is believed to have potential in the treatment of various diseases and conditions.
